desc: Derive the equivalence: valid numbers are exactly squares \(x^2\) where \(x\) has exactly two distinct prime factors.
Implement and verify an efficient distinct-prime-factor-count sieve up to \(10^6\).
Build a prefix array of the largest admissible root and answer each query using integer square root.
Check boundary cases such as \(A=36\), exact matches, and \(A=10^{12}\).
